notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681582/1aeb8637fdc866595424185bb9a1a8e822c21173.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that D3PUBLISHER's brand-new action shooting [b]"FULL METAL SCHOOLGIRL"[/b] is now available for pre-order on Steam![/p][p]Purchase during pre-order period and the first 14 days of launch to receive [b]10% off[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681582/8529f5097f035403e3637fc6afa13074392e4c33.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Pre-order to receive the in game item, [b]Accessory -"Furball" in 3 Color Varieties[/b]! (*1)[/p][p]For a limited time, receive [b]Akemi Costume: Saki's Battle Suit from "OneeChanbara ORIGIN"[/b] as an early purchase bonus. notes.title: Extra Mission Pack AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0u-cJBI15Mg;full][/previewyoutube]
A collection of additional missions featuring many new enemies that did not appear in the main game.

Included in this collection is another story that took place in the time line corresponding to missions 79 to 83 of the main game. It depicts the anguish and conflict of a certain separate unit and the end of a secret EDF weapon that was never deployed in actual combat in the main game.

More than 10 high level missions for the elite members are included in the game. The game is recommended only for those who have completed the main game and are confident in their skills.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2831530/

notes.title: EDF6 Additional Mission Pack 2 “Visions of Malice” AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gCeR0SSPZTQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Based on data collected by the EDF Strategic Information Division, a simulator that allows users to experience battle against enemy Primers in a safe and secure manner has been developed.

The “Primer Virtual Local Warfare Simulator” is overseen by the latest AI, Malice, which analyzes a vast amount of combat data collected from all over the world.
A warning to all EDF personnel: this simulator is dangerous. The battles are unlike anything you've ever seen. Only true heroes may enter.
But for those who are willing to take on the challenge, over 100 new weapons can be obtained.

Includes 30+ unique missions and 5 difficulty levels + online co-op play.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2378088/

notes.title: Update Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195852/09d9094ced4af85ff0b78d43a27cbb9d93bda31f.png[/img]

[b]Added Option for Auto-aiming when Using Mouse[/b]
An option to toggle auto-aiming for when using a mouse has been added to the Options menu, under “Keyboard / Mouse.” This allows separate auto-aiming settings for when using a controller and for when using a mouse. 

[b]Certain Epic Online Services Features are now Selection-Based[/b]
If Epic Online Services is installed, you can now select if you want to use Epic Online Services Friends and Invites when starting the application. 
Note: If using these features, you will need to create an Epic Games account and link it to your Steam
account in order to play online. You can still play online if you choose not to use these features.
